title: Hear, See, Know, Act Cards
purpose: Help children remember the compassion and rescue sequence in Exodus 2-3.
body_markdown:
# Hear, See, Know, Act Cards

Create four cards:

- HEAR - draw an ear
- SEE - draw an eye
- KNOW - draw a heart or thinking face
- ACT - draw footsteps

Add a fifth Moses card to show the person God sent.
